profile.nameJa: エフライム山地・エフライムの地
profile.subtitleJa: ヨシュアの墓所が置かれた高地地域
profile.summaryJa: 士師記2:9は、ヨシュアが葬られたティムナト・ヘレスを「エフライムの山地」に置きます。この名は町一つでなく、中央山地の広域を指します。
profile.identityNoteJa: ここでは「エフライム山地」や「エフライムの地」を地域名として扱い、エフライム部族の人々や祖先エフライム本人とは区別します。

facts.textJa: エフドはエフライム山地で角笛を吹き、そこからイスラエルの人々が下った。
デボラのなつめやしの木はラマとベテルの間、エフライム山地にあった。
歌はエフライムから来た人々・部隊の出発を述べる地理的表現。部族の人々そのものとは区別。
ギデオンはエフライム山地へ使者を送り、ヨルダンの渡河点を守るよう求めた。
トラはエフライム山地のシャミルに住んだと記す。
エフタの発言に「エフライムとマナセの中」という地域的な位置表現がある。
アブドンはエフライムの地、アマレク人の山地に葬られた。
ミカはエフライム山地の人として初登場する。
ベツレヘムから来たレビ人はエフライム山地のミカの家へ到着した。
ダン人の斥候はエフライム山地にあるミカの家で宿泊した。
斥候たちはミカの家へ向かう途上でエフライム山地を通った。
レビ人はエフライム山地の奥に住んでいた。
ギブアの老人はエフライム山地出身と説明される。
旅人はベツレヘムからエフライム山地へ向かう途中だと説明する。

profile.modernLocationJa: 中央山地の古代地域名です。正確な境界は確定せず、現代の行政区域と同一視できません。
profile.historicalRoleJa: 士師記2:9で、ヨシュアを葬ったティムナト・ヘレスの位置を示す山地として初出します。
profile.locationNoteJa: 地図上の候補は地域のおおよその目安で、境界線や中心地を示しません。

wikipedia.title: Tribe of Ephraim
wikipedia.noteJa: 「Tribal territory」節はヨシュア記に描かれるエフライムの領域を説明します。士師記の「山地」という呼び方や現代の境界線そのものと同一視はできません。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath Heres, in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.
When he had come, he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel went down with him from the hill country, and he led them.
She lived under Deborah’s palm tree between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.
Those whose root is in Amalek came out of Ephraim, after you, Benjamin, among your peoples. Governors come down out of Machir. Those who handle the marshal’s staff came out of Zebulun.

Gideon sent messengers throughout all the hill country of Ephraim, saying, “Come down against Midian and take the waters before them as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan!” So all the men of Ephraim were gathered together and took the waters as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan.
After Abimelech, Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, arose to save Israel. He lived in Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim.

Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim. The men of Gilead struck Ephraim, because they said, “You are fugitives of Ephraim, you Gileadites, in the middle of Ephraim, and in the middle of Manasseh.”
Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.
There was a man of the hill country of Ephraim, whose name was Micah.
The man departed out of the city, out of Bethlehem Judah, to live where he could find a place, and he came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, as he traveled.

The children of Dan sent five men of their family from their whole number, men of valor, from Zorah and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land and to search it. They said to them, “Go, explore the land!” They came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, and lodged there.
They passed from there to the hill country of Ephraim, and came to the house of Micah.
In those days, when there was no king in Israel, there was a certain Levite living on the farther side of the hill country of Ephraim, who took for himself a concubine out of Bethlehem Judah.
Behold, an old man came from his work out of the field at evening. Now the man was from the hill country of Ephraim, and he lived in Gibeah; but the men of the place were Benjamites.

He said to him, “We are passing from Bethlehem Judah to the farther side of the hill country of Ephraim. I am from there, and I went to Bethlehem Judah. I am going to the LORD’s house; and there is no one who has taken me into his house.
